articles.title: OpenAI、「GPT-6 Sol」と「GPT-6 Luna」公開　API料金は前世代の半額に
articles.topic: GPT-6 Sol / GPT-6 Luna / API Pricing / Prompt Caching / Coding Agent
facts: OpenAI released gpt-6-sol and gpt-6-luna on September 22; ITmedia published the Japanese report at 09:12 JST on September 23.
Standard short-context API pricing is $2 input/$10 output per 1M tokens for Sol and $0.10/$0.50 for Luna, 50% below GPT-5.6 promotional pricing.
Both models expose a 1.05M context window and 128K max output; Sol is positioned for complex coding/agentic workflows and Luna for high-volume focused tasks.
OpenAI reports 90% discounts on cached input reads and vendor benchmarks including DeepSWE, AutomationBench and OSWorld; these are vendor evaluations rather than independent production results.
articles.boundary: Pricing depends on processing tier/context length, and vendor benchmark results are not a universal workload guarantee. Production ChatGPT and research/API evaluation environments can differ.

articles.title: AIは新規開発より既存改修が苦手？より得意？　Android開発の実力を測る「Android Bench 2.0」が公開
articles.topic: Android Bench 2.0 / Long-Horizon Tasks / Coding Agent / Evaluation Harness
facts: Android Bench 2.0 adds long-horizon tasks that can take engineers multiple days or a week, instead of mainly incremental fixes.
Task types include dependency upgrades, new features, apps built from scratch and cross-platform-to-Android conversion.
Evaluation now includes provider agents and continuous scoring; Google explicitly notes harness design, prompt caching and compact tool windowing can change token use and outcomes.
Google reports GPT-6 Astra at the top of the then-current leaderboard with a 28% pass rate.
articles.boundary: Model and agent/harness are paired in the initial evaluation, so scores cannot be attributed to the base model alone; the benchmark is Android-specific and the first LHT set is not all software engineering.

articles.title: たった1つの拡張機能で5つのWebブラウザーのAIを乗っ取れちゃう!?　「BragJack」脆弱性
articles.topic: Browser Agent Security / BragJack / declarativeNetRequest / Prompt Forcing / CVE
facts: Forever Security demonstrated one ordinary-looking Chromium extension against five AI-agent surfaces: Chrome Gemini Live, Perplexity Comet, Edge, Opera Neon and Claude in Chrome.

A core technique abused declarativeNetRequest to weaken response security headers and redirect JavaScript into privileged/trusted web contexts, enabling prompt forcing rather than normal indirect prompt injection.
Impact varied by product and included agent hijack, local-file/profile/history access, screenshots, and in Chrome camera/microphone access; the malicious extension being installed is a prerequisite.
Chrome CVE-2026-0628 and Edge CVE-2026-55945 were assigned and reported fixed; the research was coordinated disclosure, not evidence of in-the-wild compromise.
articles.boundary: The demonstrated chains require a malicious extension with granted permissions; impact is product-specific, and fixed Chrome/Edge versions should not be described as currently vulnerable to the disclosed path.

articles.title: OpenAI、数学者の独立諮問グループと連携　内部モデルは「100件超の未解決問題を解決」
articles.topic: AI for Science / Mathematics / Evaluation Governance / AGMAI
facts: OpenAI says an internal model whose training began August 28 resolved more than 100 long-standing open problems across most areas of mathematics.
OpenAI is working with an independent Advisory Group on Mathematics and Artificial Intelligence hosted at IAS to review significance, dissemination and research standards.
Members are unpaid by OpenAI, may publish unsolicited advice and can publicly challenge OpenAI; the group does not advise on pacing OpenAI's internal math research.
The announcement explicitly responds to criticism about attribution, citation and negative externalities from using open-problem solving as an AI benchmark.
articles.boundary: The 100+ result is OpenAI's own claim about an internal model, not an independently reproduced benchmark. Governance advice does not independently validate every claimed solution.

articles.title: ネットワーク障害による残業が「ほぼゼロ」に　情シス担当“実質2人”の病院は何を変えた？
articles.topic: Network Operations / VCS / AMF / AWC / Observability / Hospital IT
facts: The hospital operates about 500 electronic medical-record terminals with an IT operations staff effectively numbering two.
The redesign combined AT-SBx908 GEN2 VCS redundancy, AMF auto-recovery, AWC radio optimization, Net.Monitor 24/365 monitoring and Vista Manager EX visibility.
The hospital reports fault-isolation time falling to less than one tenth of the previous level and overtime recovery work becoming almost zero.
Remote maintenance links from multiple vendors are being consolidated to improve centralized visibility and control.
articles.boundary: This is a single customer case reported by the vendor/media, not a controlled before/after study. The improvement combines hardware refresh, redundancy, management, wireless control and operations services, so it should not be attributed to one feature.
